reference_roles.04: Primary posture, gaze, head motion and quiet performance; approximately 0–4 s
reference_roles.03: Task-related screen/keyboard gaze; no compulsory head sweep
reference_roles.05: Hand repositioning, unequal hand roles and pauses

test_variable: Purposeful source pose plus minimum corresponding action-prompt change; no input seed control. Not a still-only causal experiment.
stages: Generate one revised source still under the explicit user budget exception, recording its unknown cost.
Inspect full frame and face/hand/device close-ups; reject implausible contact before any video call.
Only after still passes, submit one image-to-video shot using same-video ledger and persist request ID.
Compare current clip, new still and new clip at equal scale; review 0–3.6 s normal-speed window plus entire source clip chronology.
Record hands, gaze, posture, purposeful movement and overall naturalness separately; report regressions and untested dimensions. Do not replace or render the full film.
